data.name: Ejyansh
data.gender_notes: Ejyansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit 'Isha' (God) and 'Ansh' (symbol, form), Ejyansh represents the love and presence of God. This name is associated with spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name Ejyansh carries the meaning “God's love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ejyansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Divine connection, love from the universe
data.etymology: Ejyansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ejyansh total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
